lines.text: We were cracking up at his joke.

data.define: Used when something is so funny you can't stop laughing.

example.text: We were cracking up at his joke.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cracking up' about a cracked phone.

publish.title: What does "cracking up" mean?
publish.value: Cracking up = Laughing very hard. Example: "We were cracking up at his joke." (casual English, US).
